title: Your Stomach Gets a New Lining Every Few Days
description: Your stomach replaces the cells of its inner lining every few days to protect itself from its own acid.

scenes.text: Your stomach gives itself a fresh new lining every few days.
scenes.subject: stomach
scenes.say: [curious] Your stomach gives itself a fresh new lining every few days.

scenes.text: That is because stomach acid is strong enough to break down tough food, and it would slowly damage the stomach too.
scenes.say: [serious] That is because stomach acid is strong enough to break down tough food, and it would slowly damage the stomach too.

scenes.text: A thick layer of mucus protects the wall, and the cells underneath are replaced again and again.
scenes.subject: stomach
scenes.say: A thick layer of mucus protects the wall, and the cells underneath are replaced again and again.

scenes.text: Those cells only last a few days before new ones take their place, so the damage never builds up.
